_read_me: Aparna's events, newest first. Each becomes a page at /events/<id>/ and a card on /events/. To add one: put its photos in a folder (for example events-media/<id>/, any .jpg/.png/.webp), add an entry here with that folder, then run npm run content. Paths are relative to the project folder; "pack:" means the build pack folder. Photo captions come from "captions" (file name -> caption) or else from the file names (text before " - " or the whole name), so name files by what they show, never by people's names (brief rule 4). galleries: optional named sets (a folder each, shown in file-name order). video: an optional muted loop (.mp4). afterMovie: link to the full film (YouTube) once Aparna sends it, or null. launches: optional category names launched at the event (linked to their pages).
